negative_findings.description: General web search cannot retrieve individual LinkedIn 'new role' / 'excited to join' member posts for MK banking. Queries in both EN and MK returned company pages, Wikipedia and news, never a member-level announcement post.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero member-post hits across the EN seed query and the MK equivalent; LinkedIn member posts and profiles are largely excluded from public search indexes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The core hypothesis of this cell — that individuals announce moves before institutions do — is likely true, but the signal is NOT reachable by open web search. Collection must run inside LinkedIn (logged-in manual review, saved searches/alerts, or a licensed LinkedIn data product), not via crawlers.

negative_findings.description: There is no established Macedonian-language idiom equivalent to the English 'excited to join' / 'thrilled to announce' LinkedIn genre that surfaced in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK-language queries using нова позиција / ново назначување returned corporate governance pages, bank vacancy notices and trade-press appointment articles — institutional records, not self-reported posts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MK banking professionals appear to post such announcements in English even for MK roles, or not at all. Query design for this cell should lean on English announcement idioms plus MK institution names, and MK-language terms should instead be pointed at the institutional layer (Оглас за избор на Директор, именуван, Управен одбор).

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of a ManpowerGroup / Manpower franchise operating in North Macedonia, despite it being named in the cell brief.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches naming Manpower alongside Skopje recruitment returned DEKRA Arbeit Macedonia, vrabotuvanje.com, headhunting.mk, Motivi and the state Employment Agency — no Manpower MK entity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief's assumed actor list should be corrected: the MK staffing layer is DEKRA + local boutiques + the job boards, not the global staffing majors. Do not create a Manpower MK source record.

negative_findings.description: No MK executive-search firm was observed publishing named placement announcements ('we placed X as CFO of Y').
negative_findings.result_summary: ESC Macedonia, headhunting.mk, InHunt World MK and Motivi present service descriptions only; no public placement track record was visible from search-level inspection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'recruiter announces the placement' pathway is weaker in MK than in larger markets — confidentiality norms dominate. Expect recruiter sources to yield DEMAND signals (open mandates) rather than confirmed appointments; weight them accordingly.

negative_findings.description: Could not confirm dedicated LinkedIn company pages for several relevant institutions (Halkbank AD Skopje, Sparkasse Banka Skopje, Silk Road Bank, Stopanska Banka, Komercijalna banka, Payten Skopje entity) from search-level evidence.
negative_findings.result_summary: These were referenced only via Wikipedia, third-party data aggregators, or global group pages; no MK-specific LinkedIn URL was surfaced by search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pages very likely exist but are not search-visible. They are a coverage gap, not an absence — resolve by searching inside LinkedIn rather than recording them as non-existent.

coverage_gaps.description: The single most valuable object in this cell — the member-level 'new role' post and the profile Experience section — is behind login and effectively invisible to open search and to automated collection under LinkedIn's ToS.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish a sanctioned collection path: a human analyst with a LinkedIn account running saved searches and follow-lists over the ~15 MK bank pages and CaSys/Payten, plus LinkedIn Sales Navigator or Talent Insights if licensed. Budget it as a manual monthly routine, not a crawler.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn company pages were confirmed for only 6 of the ~13-15 MK banks plus CaSys; Halkbank, Sparkasse, Stopanska, Komercijalna, Silk Road, Development Bank, Centralna kooperativna banka, and the savings houses are unmapped in this layer.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run an in-LinkedIn company-name sweep using the Wikipedia 'List of banks in North Macedonia' roster plus the NBRM licensed-institution list as the authoritative actor set, and record one LinkedIn URL per institution.

coverage_gaps.description: No time-series of company-page headcount or function mix exists; the People tab is only useful as a diff, and no baseline snapshot has been taken.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Take a dated baseline snapshot (total employee count, top functions, top locations, new-hire count) for each mapped bank and payments firm now, then re-snapshot quarterly.

coverage_gaps.description: Macedonian-language coverage of the professional-network layer is thin because MK practitioners appear to use English for career announcements; Albanian-language sources (a significant MK professional community) were not covered at all in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Albanian query terms (pozicion i ri, emërim, drejtor, bankë) for Skopje/Tetovo institutions, and treat MK terms primarily as institutional-record vocabulary rather than social-post vocabulary.

coverage_gaps.description: Every high-value source in this cell involves personal data about identified individuals, and the obvious workaround sources (Datanyze/ZoomInfo/Lusha/AroundDeal) are scraped derivatives.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain a legal position before any systematic person-level collection: restrict storage to name + employer + title + public post date for individuals in senior public-facing roles, exclude contact details entirely, and document the legitimate-interest basis.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetched or liveness-checked; all are recorded from search-result evidence only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic verification pass; treat any 403 on linkedin.com as bot-defence rather than a dead source.

brief: North Macedonia's professional-network layer is real but largely un-crawlable: MK banks and CaSys maintain active LinkedIn company pages (NLB, TTK, UNIBanka, ProCredit, Capital, Post Bank, CaSys confirmed), yet member-level 'new role' posts — the cell's core hypothesis — never surfaced in open web search in either English or Macedonian, so this signal is reachable only from inside a logged-in LinkedIn session or a licensed LinkedIn data product. The recruiter sub-layer is smaller than the brief assumed: DEKRA Arbeit Macedonia, vrabotuvanje.com, headhunting.mk, ESC Macedonia and Motivi are the local actors (no Manpower MK entity was found), and none publish named placements — they yield open-mandate demand signals rather than confirmed appointments, with Stanton Chase Belgrade covering MK for regional C-suite searches. The practical compensating strength is that MK institutions themselves publish unusually precise formal records — Komercijalna banka's 'Оглас за избор на Директор' notices, Stopanska's and the Development Bank's governance pages — which, combined with bankarstvo.mk's appointment and vacancy feed, give a datable ground truth to validate anything LinkedIn suggests. Recommended posture: treat LinkedIn as a manual monthly human routine with quarterly headcount snapshots, anchor every claim on the institutional record, and get a legal position on person-level storage before scaling.
